Bay Ridge sausage and peppers.d: Grilled Italian sausage in bites, soft sweet peppers and onion, a splash of red wine vinegar.
Bay Ridge sausage and peppers.note: Payday supper for the paint store crew.

Disco fries.d: Crisp-cut potatoes under hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella. For after the last dance.
Disco fries.note: For the walk home after the floor closes.

Two slices stacked.d: Thin New York pie, tomato, oregano and mozzarella. Stack, fold, strut down 86th Street.
Two slices stacked.note: The walk down 86th Street, slices in hand.

Disco ball cake pops.d: Butter cake rolled with cream cheese, dipped in white chocolate and silver dragées, on a stick.

2001 Odyssey whisky lemon fizz.d: Blended whisky shaken with lemon and sugar, topped with lemonade and soda over ice. A lemon wheel.
2001 Odyssey whisky lemon fizz.note: A round at the bar before the floor lights up.
